Hi Angela,

Thanks for engaging with Redwood — excited to get Veridian set up so we can start the POC next month. To accelerate vendor creation and PO routing on our side, please send the items below by end of day Monday (2027-06-28) if possible: 

What we need from you (please upload to the Drive link below or reply with attachments):
- Completed supplier intake form (attached)
- W9 (PDF) for the legal entity that will receive POs
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as additional insured if available
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, routing, account number) — use attached payment template
- Billing contact name/email + remit-to postal address
- Primary technical contact for kickoff call (name, email, timezone)

What we will do on our side:
- Create Veridian vendor record and route POs to the billing contact you provide
- Confirm payment terms (standard is Net 30 unless contract specifies otherwise)
- Schedule a 30-minute supplier kickoff to finalize invoicing and technical onboarding

Quick notes on POs and invoices:
- Invoices should reference Redwood PO number once issued; without a PO there may be payment delays
- Send invoices to invoicing@redwood.com and cc the Billing contact we set in the vendor record
- For one-off SOWs, please include the executed SOW number on the invoice

Drive folder for uploads: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Veridian-Onboarding-Docs
Requested due date: 2027-06-28 (we can be flexible — let me know if you need more time)

If helpful, Alex (cc'd) can join a short call to walk through the intake form.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you live.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen

Hi Angela / Joe,

Thanks for the quick reply — 6/27 upload works fine. Answers below: 

- Vendor portal: Not required. If you upload the items to the shared Drive link or reply to this thread with attachments, our procurement team will create the vendor record and no separate portal registration is necessary.
- Invoices: Email invoices to invoicing@redwood.com. Once the PO is issued, please put the PO number on the invoice. We do not require a separate upload.
- W9 legal name: The PO must match the legal name on the W9. If Veridian wants POs issued to the subsidiary, please return a W9 for that specific subsidiary.

Next steps / action items (from Redwood):
- I will create the preliminary vendor record after we receive the W9 + bank details and confirm billing contact.
- Alex will issue the initial PO once the vendor record is active; expected timing 1-2 business days after vendor creation.
- I've scheduled a 30-minute supplier kickoff for 2027-06-29 10:00 AM PT (ICS attached) — if that time doesn't work, propose alternatives and we'll adjust.

If you want, we can run through the invoice/PO example on the kickoff call to prevent any processing delays.

Thanks — talk soon.
